The observable is shared and will replay the last value.A query initiated by the function will be disposed when the current injection context is destroyed, by dispatching a DisposeQuery command targetting the query instance.useQueryLoadingCreates a signal in the current injection context whose value is true only if some queries of the given type are pending, which means they have been started but have not yet resolved or errored. The signal is initialized to true.Only the queries started after the signal is created are monitored.A selector function can be optionally provided to further narrow down which specific queries of the given type are monitored.
